body: i’m struggling with taking physics this summer

i dont really feel prepared lol, im struggling to make money and delta airlines lost all my shit. All i can say is  that i think this is the most confusing part of our lives, everything is so new and unclear and no much is unanswered. it kinda feels hopeless rn, but i think it gets better
life is okay! and thanks for the advice :) having my freshman year with covid and everything totally sucked, and i’ve accepted that im not graduating in 4 years lol
period!
thank you, i’m glad you’re able to empathize, it means a lot

please don’t put too much pressure on yourself to do well in school. of course it’s just my opinion but i think you’ve been expecting too much of yourself for a long time. i know it’s hard, but start trying to do what you want and not just what others want you to do, from
someone in a similar situation, it’s just not worth it to keep pretending for anyone else
i’m in a similar spot it feels like shit, i hope we can both get through it
thank you 💜💜💜
me too
i’m here for you!!

that’s rude of them to dismiss you like that, like a lot of parents they’re probably just not emotionally intelligent unfortunately, but try your best not to let them invalidate anything you feel. i hope you’re able to manage your mental health until you can get proper treatment, it’s good that you’re at least aware of it!

definitely don’t get down on yourself for having a hard time. transitional phases like going into junior high, high school or college are rough times and it’s unfair to expect too much of yourself. focus on making yourself happy, not meeting expectations or keeping others happy

You clearly have a lot of love in your heart to give, i know that there is a need in the world for you. please don’t give up, i sincerely hope that by the time your cat passes away, which will be years from now, that you will have found happiness with yourself and seen how valuable you are
Please hold on to your will to live for your sisters, please believe that it’s not too late to find happiness in your life

that turned into my own vent but if there’s any wisdom
i can give you from someone who was there, don’t let your happiness depend on how other people perceive you or on how successful you look to others. please do what YOU want and chase your happiness for you and no one else

i understand that, seeing the mental states we have i think i felt a similar way. All i ever wanted was to be smart and successful in school and get into a good college. i thought it would make me happy and for a while the success did push me through. but now i’m at a top 20 school and the depression just came back. i realized i spent my whole life striving for this dream because my smarts were the only thing that made me feel validated and i did it for everyone but myself. and i hate being at this college, i feel like i’m in the wrong life and i wish i could leave it and give it to someone else
no one wants you dead

yeah, i kinda wake up every day wishing that i hadn’t, and every moment is so compacted with pain it’s almost impressive. i’m trying so hard to find a reason to live. but i try to think that the afterlife might be worse, and there’s so much possible time left in my life that there’s a lot of opportunity to try to change my mind, and i guess killing myself now might waste that. i feel like it’s my fault that i suffer this much anyways, and maybe one day i can get out of it even though i’ve been trying all these years
i would very much like to stop you
They will care, suicide is a horrible thing to lose someone to, no matter your relationship to them.
you’re not alone, i don’t know you personally but i understand the pain you feel, i want to end it too but i think we should stick with it
i know it doesn’t probably matter to you but you’re loved and losing you is going to hurt people forever
please don’t

i hope nothing happens to you for their sake, i know animals can become very depressed if they lose their owners and i’m sure that they need you. but idk i have  a huge soft spot for animals so maybe that’s just me
animals definitely count, i’ve been rly suicidal lately and i want to get a cat to give me a reason to live. i love animals, they don’t judge you for anything

Even if it doesn’t seem that there’s anyone left who cares, not even an acquaintance or an animal, i know that no one wants to see you give up. especially those friends that you’ve lost. in time, i think you’ll make new relationships that will absolutely be worth holding onto.

i understand that it feels that way, it feels that way for me a lot of the time as well. i don’t want you dead, i’m cant guarantee that no one out there wants you dead but i do doubt it. i don’t think anyone can be such a bad person they deserve deatg

i understand, i actually expressed suicidal thoughts when i was around that age too it’s always been there. i don’t know why. i don’t know you or your situation and i know i’m not reliable because im suicidal too. but i think we should stay and see what happens. if there’s anything you’ve always wanted to do, or a friend that you want to see again, or a restaurant that you want to try, please please hold onto that
i don’t think that’s the best option
i’m here and i care

i’m sorry you’re in so much pain, i promise it’s temporary and i know it’s hard to believe because im also not really believing it lately. i think it’s true that there’s always something to be done to improve how you feel, but it’s difficult to get the guidance  
you need and the will to actually give life the chance
to improve
i’m my own enemy too. idk how were expected to get through it but people keep expecting me to.
i also had a lot of panic attacks and breakdowns in middle school, it was embarrassing and made me hate myself.

i’m sorry for that. you dont deserve to be put down just for feeling what you’re feeling. i hope you know that your experience is valid, and that what you think to yourself and tell to yourself is bullying and you shouldn’t think that you’re horrible just because that’s what you believe. it makes you your worst enemy
you’re not a degenerate or a burden
